issue_paraphrase: When metadata keyword evaluation is enabled and a configured keyword value combines literal text with a {placeholder} (for example a URL template such as 'https://.../{filename}'), the program crashes mid-run with a TypeError of the form 'sequence item N: expected str instance, X found' whenever the placeholder resolves to a non-text value (a number, a date/time object, or None). The same keyword values work fine when they consist of only a single placeholder with no surrounding text.
fix_summary: StringFormatter was joining the results of per-field format functions with ''.join(), which requires every piece to already be str. With the default 'format' builtin every result is a str, but a caller-supplied custom fmt function (e.g. util.identity as used by the keywords-eval feature, or int) can return int/datetime/None. The fix adds format_map_safe which wraps each result in str() and is selected whenever a non-default fmt is passed and the format string has multiple parts.
notes: Fully self-contained, no network, runs in <0.1s. test_formatter.py collects and runs standalone (jinja2 is imported with a fallback). gallery-dl does not need pip-installing itself; tests add the repo root to sys.path.

issue_paraphrase: When '--mtime' is enabled with a date-based value, files whose metadata lacks a valid date/time end up with a wrong modification timestamp: the timestamp from a previously downloaded file can stick to the next file, and metadata that contains an invalid or missing date value is not handled as 'no date', so the intended file modification time is either silently not set or set to an absurd value. A run that processes several files can stamp several of them with the same wrong modification time.
fix_summary: MtimePP.run() computed _mtime_meta only when the raw metadata value was not None and otherwise returned early, leaving a previous file's _mtime_meta in the shared kwdict; a NullDatetime sentinel for 'no date' also passed the None check and produced a timestamp of year 0001. The fix always assigns _mtime_meta (None when the value is missing/falsy/invalid) using a walrus-style truthiness check, so stale entries are cleared and invalid dates never reach os.utime. It also added regression tests (test_mtime_none_dt, test_mtime_invalid) and updated the assertions of the None/undefined tests.
notes: Self-contained, no network, ~0.3s for the MtimeTest class. The direct reproduction avoids the extractor import machinery; running the pytest goldens requires restoring 8 stub extractor modules first (see install recipe in notes below): the GitHub mirror omits exhentai/nhentai/hitomi/hdoujin/hentaifoundry/hentaihand/hentainexus/schalenetwork while gallery_dl/extractor/__init__.py still lists them, so extractor.find() raises ModuleNotFoundError otherwise (files exist in the PyPI wheel for the same release).

issue_paraphrase: When a site returns a file with zero bytes (Content-Length 0), the downloader treats it as a successful download: it writes an empty file, prints no warning, and the run records it as a success (for example in an archive database). With several files, a broken upstream can quietly fill the archive with empty files. The expected behavior is to warn about the empty file and treat that download as failed.
fix_summary: In HttpDownloader.download(), after the Content-Length (size) header is parsed, a zero size now short-circuits: the connection is released, a WARNING 'Empty file' is logged, and download() returns False so the file is not written and the run does not record a success. A regression test (test_http_empty plus a b'~NUL' sample served by the module's embedded local HTTP server) was added.
notes: Self-contained, no network (local HTTP server in the test module), ~0.3s. test_downloader.py needs the same stub modules as candidate #8918 for collection. To build the stubs after any git reset --hard, write a module defining a StubExtractor class with a pattern attribute that never matches (e.g. pattern = re.compile(r'(?!)')) to gallery_dl/extractor/$m.py for m in exhentai hdoujin hentaifoundry hentaihand hentainexus hitomi nhentai schalenetwork; this keeps extractor.find() working.
